name: Footwork Series
summary: Leg presses from the footbar through several foot positions. A steady way to start a reformer class and check alignment.

layers.title: Parallel heels and toes
layers.text: Press out and return with control.

layers.title: Add tendon stretch
layers.text: Lower and lift the heels at full extension.

cautions.note: Keep the knees soft at full extension; reduce range if painful.

review.note: Starter entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
